scope: Six 1:50,000 sheets: original four central/southern references plus Gdańsk and Mikoszewo city/coastal sheets. Remaining western and northeastern edge strips are still deferred.
coordinate_note: Geographic neatline bounds read from the map grid; original maps use coordinate system 1942. Bounds are suitable for identifying sheet coverage, not a completed georeferencing transform.

maps.date_notes: Heading: Wydanie pierwsze PRL 1970–74; source material dated 1963/74, 1962/74, 1970.
maps.notes: Partial red railway reading aid, added programmatically over the original scan. Includes identifiable standard and narrow-gauge sections; uncertain historical branches and some marginal sections remain unmarked. Not a complete historical inventory or survey-accurate digitization. Decimal-degree labels added on 2026-11-08 at every one-minute division on all four borders. Labels express the printed 1942 datum, not converted WGS84. Blank annotation strips added outside the map; mapped area and existing railway highlights were not resampled.
maps.rail_overlay_coverage: Small coastal edge fragment only; historical inland alignments not confidently identified.
